name: test
# This is the main CI workflow that runs the test suite on all pushes to main
# and all pull requests. It runs the following jobs:
# - required: runs the test suite on ubuntu with stable and beta rust
# toolchains.
# - os-check: runs the test suite on mac and windows.
# - coverage: runs the test suite and collects coverage information.
# See `check.yml` for information about how the concurrency cancellation and
# workflow triggering works.
permissions:
  contents: read
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, v*]
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
      - "**.adoc"
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
      - "**.adoc"
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
jobs:
  required:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: ubuntu / ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        # Run on stable and beta to ensure that tests won't break on the next
        # version of the rust toolchain.
        toolchain: [stable, beta]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Install rust ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
          rustflags: ""

      - name: "Install nextest"
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest

      - name: Cargo generate-lockfile
        # Enable this ci template to run regardless of whether the lockfile is
        # checked in or not.
        if: hashFiles('Cargo.lock') == ''
        run: cargo generate-lockfile

        # https://twitter.com/jonhoo/status/1571290371124260865
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: cargo nextest run --locked --all-targets -p openzeppelin-stylus -p openzeppelin-stylus-proc -p openzeppelin-crypto --features ruint

        # https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/6669
      - name: Run doc tests
        run: cargo test --locked --doc
  os-check:
    # Run cargo test on MacOS and Windows.
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / stable
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest]
        # Windows fails because of `stylus-proc`.
        # os: [macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Install rust
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Function to retrieve all Cargo.toml paths in the ./examples directory
get_example_dirs() {
  find ./examples -maxdepth 2 -type f -name "Cargo.toml" | xargs -n1 dirname | sort
}

# Get the root directory of the git repository
ROOT_DIR=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
cd "$ROOT_DIR" || exit

# Check contract ABI by crate name
check_abi() {
  local CRATE_PATH=$1

  echo "Checking contract $CRATE_PATH"

  echo

  cd "$CRATE_PATH"

  cargo stylus export-abi

  echo

  echo "Done!"

  echo

  cd "$ROOT_DIR"
}


for CRATE_PATH in $(get_example_dirs); do
  check_abi "$CRATE_PATH"
done

name: test
# This is the main CI workflow that runs the test suite on all pushes to main
# and all pull requests. It runs the following jobs:
# - required: runs the test suite on ubuntu with stable and beta rust
# toolchains.
# - os-check: runs the test suite on mac and windows.
# - coverage: runs the test suite and collects coverage information.
# See `check.yml` for information about how the concurrency cancellation and
# workflow triggering works.
permissions:
  contents: read
on:
  push:
    branches: [main, v*]
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
      - "**.adoc"
  pull_request:
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
      - "**.adoc"
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
jobs:
  required:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: ubuntu / ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        # Run on stable and beta to ensure that tests won't break on the next
        # version of the rust toolchain.
        toolchain: [stable, beta]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Install rust ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
          rustflags: ""

      - name: "Install nextest"
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest

      - name: Cargo generate-lockfile
        # Enable this ci template to run regardless of whether the lockfile is
        # checked in or not.
        if: hashFiles('Cargo.lock') == ''
        run: cargo generate-lockfile

        # https://twitter.com/jonhoo/status/1571290371124260865
      - name: Run unit tests
        run: cargo nextest run --locked --all-targets -p openzeppelin-stylus -p openzeppelin-stylus-proc -p openzeppelin-crypto --features ruint

        # https://github.com/rust-lang/cargo/issues/6669
      - name: Run doc tests
        run: cargo test --locked --doc
  os-check:
    # Run cargo test on MacOS and Windows.
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} / stable
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [macos-latest]
        # Windows fails because of `stylus-proc`.
        # os: [macos-latest, windows-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          submodules: true

      - name: Install rust
#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Function to retrieve all Cargo.toml paths in the ./examples directory
get_example_dirs() {
  find ./examples -maxdepth 2 -type f -name "Cargo.toml" | xargs -n1 dirname | sort
}

# Get the root directory of the git repository
ROOT_DIR=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
cd "$ROOT_DIR" || exit

# Check contract ABI by crate name
check_abi() {
  local CRATE_PATH=$1

  echo "Checking contract $CRATE_PATH"

  echo

  cd "$CRATE_PATH"

  cargo stylus export-abi

  echo

  echo "Done!"

  echo

  cd "$ROOT_DIR"
}


for CRATE_PATH in $(get_example_dirs); do
  check_abi "$CRATE_PATH"
done

import re

files = [
    'erc20/mod.rs',
    'erc20/extensions/burnable.rs',
    'erc20/extensions/erc4626.rs',
    'erc20/extensions/flash_mint.rs',
    'erc20/extensions/wrapper.rs',
    'erc20/utils/safe_erc20.rs',
]

impl_re = re.compile(r'^([ ]*)#\[public\]\n\1impl [A-Za-z0-9_<>:=, ]+ for [A-Za-z0-9_]+ \{\n', re.M)

total = 0
for f in files:
    s = open(f).read()
    out = []
    pos = 0
    count = 0
    for m in impl_re.finditer(s):
        start = m.end()
        indent = m.group(1)
        # Find the end of the impl block: first line equal to `indent + "}"` after start.
        end_marker = '\n' + indent + '}\n'
        end = s.index(end_marker, start) + 1
        block = s[start:end]
        t = re.search(r'type Error = ([^;]+);', block)
        if not t:
            continue
        concrete = t.group(1).strip()
        n = block.count('Self::Error')
        if n:
            new_block = block.replace('Self::Error', concrete)
            out.append(s[pos:start])
            out.append(new_block)
            pos = end
            count += n
    out.append(s[pos:])
    new_s = ''.join(out)
    open(f, 'w').write(new_s)
    print(f, count)
    total += count
print('total', total)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Builds the commit series of the erc20 branch from saved file states.

States (all under /tmp/bench/exp/erc20-snap):
  fmt-tree  HEAD files after rustfmt only
  migrated  non-test migration + migrated tests
  final     migrated + additional tests
"""
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

WT = "/tmp/bench/wt/erc20"
SNAP = "/tmp/bench/exp/erc20-snap"
TRAILER = "Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"

FILES = [
    "contracts/src/token/common/erc2981.rs",
    "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/burnable.rs",
    "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/capped.rs",
    "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/erc4626.rs",
    "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/flash_mint.rs",
    "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/metadata.rs",
    "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/permit.rs",
    "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/wrapper.rs",
    "contracts/src/token/erc20/mod.rs",
    "contracts/src/token/erc20/utils/safe_erc20.rs",
]


def read(path):
    with open(path) as fh:
        return fh.read()


def write(path, text):
    with open(path, "w") as fh:
        fh.write(text)


def split_tests(text):
    """Returns (code, tests): `tests` starts at the attributes and comments
    attached to the `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` item (or is empty)."""
    marker = "#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {"
    idx = text.find(marker)
    if idx == -1:
        return text, ""
    lines = text[:idx].split("\n")
    # lines[-1] is "" (text before marker ends with a newline).
    end = len(lines) - 1
    while end > 0 and (lines[end - 1].startswith("#[") or lines[end - 1].startswith("//")):
        end -= 1
    code = "\n".join(lines[:end])
    if end > 0:
        code += "\n"
    return code, text[len(code):]


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", WT, *args], check=True,
                          capture_output=True, text=True).stdout


def stage_and_commit(paths, message):
    git("add", "--", *paths)
    body = message.rstrip("\n") + "\n\n" + TRAILER + "\n"
    git("commit", "-q", "-m", body)
    print(git("log", "--oneline", "-1").strip())


def state_path(state, rel):
    return os.path.join(SNAP, state, rel)


def fmt_path(rel):
    return os.path.join(SNAP, "fmt-tree", rel)


def put(rel, text):
    write(os.path.join(WT, rel), text)


def main():
    # Sanity: working tree must hold the final state, which is saved already.
    for rel in FILES:
        assert read(os.path.join(WT, rel)) == read(state_path("final", rel)), rel

    # 1. formatting only.
    for rel in FILES:
        put(rel, read(fmt_path(rel)))
    stage_and_commit(FILES, """refactor(erc20): restore rustfmt formatting of the module

The mechanical import rewrite of the SDK bump left the imports, trailing commas
and braces of the ERC-20 and ERC-2981 modules unformatted. Run the repository's
rustfmt on them. No code changes.""")

    # 2. non-test migration.
    for rel in FILES:
        code, _ = split_tests(read(state_path("migrated", rel)))
        _, tests = split_tests(read(fmt_path(rel)))
        put(rel, code + tests)
    stage_and_commit(FILES, """refactor(erc20): use the host access and call contexts of SDK 0.10

Finish moving the ERC-20 module off the SDK 0.9 globals:

- Calls to other contracts pass the host (`self.vm()`) to the `sol_interface!`
  methods. Views use `Call::new()`, the flash loan receiver hook and the
  ERC-1363 calls bind `Call::new_mutating(self)` before borrowing the host.
- `SafeErc20::call_optional_return` becomes a method so it can reach the host
  for `RawCall::new` and the code check, which is now
  `AddressUtils::has_code`. The bool result is still decoded with validation
  (`abi_decode_validate`, the equivalent of the old `abi_decode(.., true)`).
- Tag the public interface traits with `#[public]` and allow `missing_docs` on
  them: the macro adds an undocumented helper method.
- Name the error type instead of `Self::Error` in the `#[public]` trait impls:
  with `export-abi` the macro generates the ABI printer on a marker struct
  where `Self::Error` does not resolve. The types are the same.
- Allow `clippy::too_many_arguments` on the generated `onFlashLoan` call, which
  now takes the host as well.
- Fix the docs that named the removed accessors.

The public Rust API, the storage layout and the ABI do not change.""")

    # 3a. tests of the ERC-20 core and its small extensions.
    group = [
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/mod.rs",
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/burnable.rs",
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/capped.rs",
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/metadata.rs",
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/erc4626.rs",
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/flash_mint.rs",
    ]
    for rel in group:
        put(rel, read(state_path("migrated", rel)))
    stage_and_commit(group, """test(erc20): run the ERC-20 and extension unit tests on the TestVM

Replace the motsu contracts by `TestVM`s and `T::from(&vm)`, the injected
accounts by the fixtures of `test_utils` and `contract.sender(x)` by
`vm.set_sender(x)`. Every scenario and assertion is kept. The events are
checked with a helper that looks the encoded log up in `vm.get_emitted_logs()`.""")

    # 3b. tests that call the underlying token.
    group = [
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/wrapper.rs",
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/utils/safe_erc20.rs",
    ]
    for rel in group:
        put(rel, read(state_path("migrated", rel)))
    stage_and_commit(group, """test(erc20): mock the calls to the underlying token in the wrapper and SafeErc20 tests

A `TestVM` cannot call into another contract, so the token that motsu ran as a
second contract becomes an `Erc20` in its own VM, and the calls the contract
under test makes to it are mocked with the outcome of the same call on that
token. That keeps the checks of the balances, allowances and events of the
token. One mock is registered right before the call that reads it, because the
`TestVM` returns the data of the last registered mock to every call.

`deposit_for_reverts_when_invalid_asset` was ignored because of a motsu issue
with calling an account without code. It works on the `TestVM`, so it runs now.
`recover_reverts_when_invalid_underlying` stays ignored: `_recover` reports the
address of the wrapper, not the one of the underlying token, in
`ERC20InvalidUnderlying`, which the test does not expect.""")

    # 3c. ERC-2981.
    group = ["contracts/src/token/common/erc2981.rs"]
    for rel in group:
        put(rel, read(state_path("migrated", rel)))
    stage_and_commit(group, """test(erc2981): run the unit tests on the TestVM

Same conversion as for the ERC-20 tests, with the `BOB` and `DAVE` fixtures of
`test_utils` for the royalty receivers. Every scenario and assertion is kept.""")

    # 4. additional tests.
    group = [
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/erc4626.rs",
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/flash_mint.rs",
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/permit.rs",
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/extensions/wrapper.rs",
        "contracts/src/token/erc20/utils/safe_erc20.rs",
    ]
    for rel in group:
        put(rel, read(state_path("final", rel)))
    stage_and_commit(group, """test(erc20): cover the migrated call sites with mocked calls

The motsu tests only exercised accounts without code, so most of the call sites
that the SDK migration touched (code check, call context, host argument,
decoding of the answer, error mapping) were covered by the end-to-end tests
alone. `TestVM::set_code` and the `mock_*` helpers make them testable natively:
the flash loan with its receiver hook, the vault flows and the constructor of
`Erc4626` against a mocked asset, the outcomes of a token call and the ERC-1363
variants of `SafeErc20`, the default decimals of the wrapper, and `permit` with
a mocked `ecRecover`. These are additional tests, none of the migrated ones
depends on them.""")

    for rel in FILES:
        assert read(os.path.join(WT, rel)) == read(state_path("final", rel)), rel
    print(git("status", "--short"))
    print("done")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

content.text:
**ERC-20 + ERC-2981 migration, branch `agent/erc20`, HEAD `f05b149`**

**Files:** `token/common/erc2981.rs` and `token/erc20/{mod.rs, extensions/{burnable,capped,erc4626,flash_mint,metadata,permit,wrapper}.rs, utils/safe_erc20.rs}`. `interface.rs`, the other `mod.rs` files and `token/mod.rs` needed no change.

**Commits** (`7e36233..HEAD`; each ends with only the Haiku trailer):
```
27155f6 refactor(erc20): restore rustfmt formatting of the module
da6945f refactor(erc20): use the host access and call contexts of SDK 0.10
bbe8ff8 test(erc20): run the ERC-20 and extension unit tests on the TestVM
9267595 test(erc20): mock the token calls in the wrapper and SafeErc20 tests
1d9053c test(erc2981): run the unit tests on the TestVM
f05b149 test(erc20): cover the migrated call sites with mocked calls   (additional tests only)
```

**Signature changes:** no public item changed.
- Private: `SafeErc20::call_optional_return` went from an associated fn to a `&self` method, because it needs the host. `Erc4626::try_get_asset_decimals` went from `&mut self` to `&self`.
- In `#[public]` trait impls (`IErc20`, `IErc20Burnable`, `ISafeErc20`, plus test fixtures), `Self::Error` is now the concrete error type (E0220 under `export-abi`).
- All 10 `pub trait I...` carry `#[public]` and `#[allow(missing_docs)]` with the access-style reason comment. The generated `onFlashLoan` call got `#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]`.
- `Bool::abi_decode(&d, true)` became `abi_decode_validate`, which keeps the same semantics. A new test pins it.

**Tests** (before -> after, migrated + additional):

| file | before -> after |
|---|---|
| `erc2981.rs` | 24 -> 24 |
| `erc20/mod.rs` | 17 -> 17 |
| `burnable.rs` | 5 -> 5 |
| `capped.rs` | 1 -> 1 |
| `metadata.rs` | 2 -> 2 |
| `erc4626.rs` | 7 -> 7 + 8 |
| `flash_mint.rs` | 9 -> 9 + 5 |
| `wrapper.rs` | 17 -> 17 + 1 |
| `safe_erc20.rs` | 4 -> 4 + 12 |
| `permit.rs` | 0 -> 0 + 3 |

Total is 86 -> 86 + 29 = 115. None were merged or removed.
- **Cross-contract tests:** in wrapper and `safe_erc20`, the token is a real `Erc20` in its own `TestVM`. The contract's call to it is mocked with that token's result, so the balance, allowance and event assertions are kept. Each mock is registered right before the call that reads it.
- **Un-ignored:** `deposit_for_reverts_when_invalid_asset` was ignored for a motsu issue; it now passes.
- **Still ignored:** `recover_reverts_when_invalid_underlying`, with a new reason. `_recover` puts the wrapper's own address in `ERC20InvalidUnderlying`, while the test expects the underlying token's. This predates the migration; I left behavior unchanged.
- **Shared helper:** `assert_emitted` is `pub(crate)` in `erc20::tests` and reused by the wrapper, `erc4626` and `permit` tests.

**Compile status:**
- **Real worktree (base `7e36233`):** my files have 0 errors in both lib and test target. The whole crate still fails there on finance, proxy, erc1155, erc721 and utils files.
- **Throwaway copy** (`bench` b3024bc + `agent/utils` + mine, without proxy and erc721): all 434 tests pass with 1 ignored, and `clippy --all-targets -D warnings` is clean.
- **`export-abi`:** my files compile with `--features export-abi`.
- **Formatting and docs:** nightly rustfmt is clean, and rustdoc is clean except the `erc721` links in `safe_erc20.rs`, which only fail because erc721 was left out of the copy.
- **Examples:** 6 of 7 erc20-related examples compile against the module. `examples/safe-erc20` fails on its own `stylus_sdk::evm` import.

**Requests:**
1. `export-abi` (E0220 on `Self::Error`) still fails in merged `access/control/{mod,extensions/enumerable}.rs`, `access/ownable_two_step.rs` and `finance/vesting_wallet.rs`.
2. Files I don't own still write `Result<_, Self::Error>` in `#[public]` impls:
   - `examples/{erc20,erc20-permit,erc20-flash-mint,erc20-wrapper,erc4626,safe-erc20,basic/token}`
   - `docs/modules/ROOT/pages/erc20*.adoc` and `erc4626.adoc`
   - the `contracts/src/lib.rs` crate docs
   - `examples/safe-erc20` also needs its `stylus_sdk::evm` import removed.

**Unsure:**
- `TestVM` answers an unmatched call with `Ok(<last mocked data>)` and never records calls, so mock-based tests don't verify calldata.
- The 29 additional tests are my addition. Drop `f05b149` if you don't want them; nothing else depends on it.
- Logs are in `/tmp/bench/logs/erc20-*.log`. The scratch crates are `/tmp/bench/exp/erc20-iso` and `/tmp/bench/exp/erc20-int`.
